sponsored.t: Prohibits the issuance of permits that authorize road work during certain time periods
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the issuance of permits that authorize road work during certain time periods otherwise known as rush hour.

sponsored.t: Prohibits persons who were sentenced for a crime involving unlawful sexual conduct or assault from using public transportation
sponsored.sum: Prohibits persons who were sentenced for a crime involving unlawful sexual conduct or assault from using public transportation including services in the transportation of passengers, airports, train stations, subway and rail stations, and bus terminals.

sponsored.t: Prohibits metered parking on certain streets in the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Prohibits metered parking on certain streets in the city of New York based upon the percentage of residential dwellings that make up such street.

sponsored.t: Limits the authority of municipal authorities where it concerns non-emergency regulations on grocery prices
sponsored.sum: Limits the authority of municipal authorities where it concerns non-emergency regulations on grocery prices.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to first responders
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to first responders in Kings county on state route 908H.

sponsored.t: Requires any county, city, town or village that intends to install a traffic-control device outfitted with a camera provide public notice that they are installing a traffic-control device outfitted with a camera
sponsored.sum: Requires any county, city, town or village that intends to install a traffic-control device outfitted with a camera provide public notice that they are installing a traffic-control device outfitted with a camera.

sponsored.t: Prohibits youthful offender status for persons who commit a hate crime
sponsored.sum: Prohibits youthful offender status for persons who commit a hate crime.

sponsored.t: Prohibits persons affiliated with terror organizations from being appointed to permanent, temporary or provisional positions
sponsored.sum: Prohibits persons affiliated with terror organizations from being appointed to permanent, temporary or provisional positions in the state civil service system.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the public use of cannabis, unless approved by the applicable local government
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of cannabis in public places, unless approved by the applicable local government.

sponsored.t: Safety and Accountability of Fast-motorized and Electric (S.A.F.E.) Vehicles Speed Act
sponsored.sum: Requires all vehicles that are capable of traveling over twenty-five miles per hour to be registered and licensed with the department of motor vehicles.

sponsored.t: Prohibits hotels, motels and lodging establishments from selling prepaid rooms to another person in certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Prohibits hotels, motels and lodging establishments from selling prepaid rooms to another person if the original guest fails to check in on the first day of the scheduled reservation or if the guest fails to check in within the first, second or third night for prepaid reservations of seven days or longer; provides penalties for violations.

sponsored.t: Requires motor vehicle lease contracts to include provisions related to the accumulation of mileage
sponsored.sum: Requires motor vehicle lease contracts to include provisions related to the accumulation of mileage, specifically the amount a lessee will receive back if such lessee does not accumulate all miles that were allotted for the term of the lease.

sponsored.t: Increases the allowances provided to trial and grand jurors
sponsored.sum: Increases the allowances provided to trial and grand jurors to $60 per day for the first ten days and $100 per day every day thereafter of physical attendance.

sponsored.t: Relates to congestion pricing in New York city and establishes a committee of the metropolitan transportation authority to conduct a survey and assessment of infrastructure and ADA compliance; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to congestion pricing in New York city (Part A); establishes a committee by the metropolitan transportation authority to conduct a survey and assessment of necessary infrastructure repairs and replacements and compliance of transit stations with the ADA (Part B).

sponsored.t: Enacts the criminal street gang abatement act of 2025; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Enacts the criminal street gang abatement act which provides enhanced penalties for persons involved with criminal street gangs; establishes the crime of gang solicitation of minors on school grounds; allows for roving interceptions by police after adequate cause is shown; establishes the witness protection fund.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "Not on our dollar!: Ending New York funding of Hamas violence act"
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "Not on our dollar!: Ending New York funding of Hamas violence act" to prohibit not-for-profit corporations from engaging in unauthorized support of Hamas and nations known to fund middle-eastern terrorist group activity; allows for recovery of a civil penalty by the state attorney general; creates a private right of action for violations.

sponsored.t: Requires state agencies to submit annual reports to the financial committees of the legislature
sponsored.sum: Requires state agencies to submit annual reports to the financial committees of the legislature accounting for all fines, fees and surcharges, the purpose of such fine, fee or surcharge, and where such fines, fees, interest and surcharges were deposited; directs unassigned fees to be deposited into the general fund.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "3020-a arbitration process reporting act"
sponsored.sum: Requires annual reporting by city school districts in cities with a population of over two hundred fifty thousand regarding the arbitration process in teacher disciplinary proceedings.

sponsored.t: Excludes certain actions from reporting requirements relating to environmental quality reviews
sponsored.sum: Excludes from reporting requirements relating to environmental quality reviews actions to approve the siting or construction of housing in cities with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Relates to community land mortgages and authorizes the state of New York mortgage agency to purchase community land mortgages from banks within the state
sponsored.sum: Relates to the purchase of community land mortgages; defines a community land mortgage as a mortgage that is secured by a first lien on a leasehold estate in real property that is improved by a residential structure wherein title to the real property is retained by a not-for-profit housing company or housing development fund company; authorizes the state of New York mortgage agency to purchase community land mortgages from banks within the state; ensures not-for-profit housing remains as affordable housing.

sponsored.t: Includes mixed residential and commercial property within the affordable home ownership program
sponsored.sum: Includes mixed residential and commercial property within the provisions of the affordable home ownership development program thus authorizing the affordable housing corporation to fund the construction or rehabilitation of housing that also contains a commercial retailing business.

sponsored.t: Establishes a housing infrastructure tax credit to provide a credit of up to ten percent of costs for infrastructure projects
sponsored.sum: Establishes a housing infrastructure tax credit to provide a credit of up to ten percent of costs for infrastructure projects related to the construction of new homes or multiple dwellings commenced and completed within a specific time period.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "homebuyer renovation property tax exemption act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "homebuyer renovation property tax exemption act" to grant an exemption of up to fifteen thousand dollars from taxation levied by or on behalf of any county, city, town, village or school district in which such residential property is located for a period of five years from the date of purchase of the property; defines "primary residential property".

sponsored.t: Authorizes the establishment of the home equity protection insurance program
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the establishment of the home equity protection insurance program directing the agency to issue a commitment to insure and insure the full value of certain residences which are owner-occupied by persons who meet certain income qualifications.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the purchase of rehabilitation mortgages by the state of New York mortgage agency
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the state of New York mortgage agency to purchase rehabilitation mortgages from banks within the state during periods when there is an inadequate supply of credit available for new residential mortgages or available for such loans at carrying charges within the financial means of persons and families of low and moderate income.

sponsored.t: Eliminates certain restrictions on the right to eviction for landlord's personal use
sponsored.sum: Removes certain restrictions relating to the "immediate and compelling necessity" of the landlord on a landlord's ability in certain New York city apartments which are rent stabilized or rent controlled to recover possession of a housing accommodation for such landlord's own personal use and occupancy or for the use and occupancy of such landlord's immediate family.

sponsored.t: Provides basis for determining primary residency
sponsored.sum: Provides that non-payment of New York city taxes shall be a prima facie finding that a housing accommodation subject to the emergency housing rent control act is not a person's primary residence as claimed by the delinquent taxpayer and non-payment of NYS taxes shall be a prima facie finding that a housing accommodation subject to the emergency tenant protection act of 1974 is not a person's primary residence.

sponsored.t: Creates a homeownership rehabilitation credit
sponsored.sum: Creates a homeownership rehabilitation credit; allows a taxpayer to be credited for fifteen percent of the qualified rehabilitation expenses made by such taxpayer with respect to a qualified residence against the tax imposed; defines qualified residence and qualified rehabilitation expenses.

sponsored.t: Requires colleges and universities to provide students with written information on reporting bias related and hate crimes
sponsored.sum: Requires colleges and universities to provide students with written information on reporting bias related and hate crimes, requirements for reporting bias related and hate crimes, and protections available to those who report bias related and hate crimes.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "lifeguard incentive and debt assistance (LIDA) act"
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Lifeguard incentive and debt assistance (LIDA) act", which provides financial aid assistance to eligible students working as lifeguards during such students' academic career at a college or university in the state of New York; provides a one-time debt relief check to post-graduate students who maintain an active lifeguard certification for four years.

sponsored.t: Requires signage warning about EBT/SNAP skimming and mandates chip-enabled point-of-sale systems for SNAP transactions
sponsored.sum: Requires signage warning about EBT/SNAP skimming at all retail food stores; mandates chip-enabled point-of-sale systems for SNAP transactions.

sponsored.t: Prohibits a person from defacing or damaging a fine art or historical monument
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a person from defacing or damaging a fine art or historical monument; makes such crime bail eligible.
